seo.title: Amara at Paraiso · Waterfront Weddings & Private Events in Miami
seo.description: Weddings, private dinners and corporate events at Amara at Paraiso, Michael Schwartz’s waterfront restaurant on Biscayne Bay in Miami: a rooftop terrace, a private main floor and spaces for 40 to 750 guests. Music direction, MC and entertainment by Avinu Events.

hero.lead: Michael Schwartz’s waterfront restaurant on Biscayne Bay: a rooftop terrace, a private main floor with its own beach and patio, and Latin American flavors served family-style.

paras: Amara at Paraiso describes itself as the quintessential Miami waterfront restaurant: floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Biscayne Bay, an outdoor waterfront deck, two full bars and a rooftop lounge with a wrap-around terrace.

Events can be semi-private or fully private, from a patio dinner for 40 to the whole restaurant, with menus built around bold Latin American flavors and coastal ingredients. Parking is limited on the street, with valet on site.

spaces.note: Capacities from the venue’s 2026 event deck: full venue 750 reception / 390 seated; North Terrace 50 / 40. The venue lists some figures differently across pages, so confirm capacities and layouts with its events team.

paras: The kitchen is led by James Beard Award-winning Chef Michael Schwartz with Executive Sous Chef Maite Zarrabeitia, combining South and Central American influences with local, sustainable ingredients. Its wood-fired oven turns out seafood and meat parrilladas, and the raw bar features stone crabs.
On the dinner menu: Yuca Cheese Puffs, Hamachi Tiradito, Spicy Grilled Giant Prawns, Charcoal Grilled Octopus and a Seafood Parillada. Private events are served family-style.
highlights: Wine Spectator Best of Award of Excellence

reviews.src: Reviews from Google · Rating from Google

items.q: We had our wedding on the Amara rooftop terrace in April and it was the best venue ever! The food was delicious, vibes superb, and the planning was so seamless.
Amara at Paraiso hosted our team event on the rooftop. We had about 225 people in our party. We were accommodated so well! … The ambience and environment was gorgeous.
I selected Amara for a milestone birthday dinner. Everyone at Amara was a joy to work with. … I highly recommend them for any celebratory occasion!

I had the most incredible experience having my wedding rehearsal dinner here. … Of course the best part was the beautiful view we had all night. Highly recommend for dinner or for having a private event!

production.text: Amara allows DJs, live bands and musicians at fully private events (a Rooftop, Main Floor or full-venue buyout), with additional requirements or approvals depending on the entertainment. Avinu Events works within those rules: music direction, MC, live performers and a timeline that keeps ceremony, cocktails and dinner moving together.
production.lighting: Décor is not included with an event, and you are welcome to bring your own décor company if the venue’s Event Coordinator is informed. We design the moments that carry the room: entrances, the first dance and the energy of the night.
